Independent review of run r-20260925T132721214026-s20-gate-aware-lane, reviewed base a30208faba5b9d127391502df33e1f7e84f4f027 and reviewed head 3b42f115b522d229346d69b3bf58bc9ff8c9dc7f.

The live plan section §20 requires a lane.json admission block with queue-aware headroom and verdicts, preservation of the engine headroom, and gate_wait_s on completed and timed-out request receipts. I read the candidate manifest, all four commits, the router and receipt call sites, the focused tests, the plan landing and cumulative evidence anchor, and the candidate's gate, edge-gate, lint and negative-control logs. I independently ran the non-network admission and width tests at the reviewed head (19 passed) and whole-tree Ruff (exit 0). The full socket-backed gate rerun is retained in review-gate.log; its 22 failures all occur before test logic at aiohttp loopback bind 127.0.0.1:0, so they are an execution-host limitation rather than candidate failures.

VERDICT done_when: the candidate's initial focused gate is 65 passed at 8fc472a, the edge-corrected gate is 66 passed at 275f82d9, and both whole-tree Ruff logs exit 0. The complete rerun could not bind loopback on this host, with every failure showing the same OSError before assertions.
VERDICT write_paths: the reviewed diff has exactly five paths -- router.py, request_receipts.py, test_agent_router_admission.py, the plan and the cumulative evidence archive -- all within the candidate scope, and the candidate worktree is clean.
VERDICT manifest: the candidate manifest's commits, paths, logs and negative-control path agree with the files on disk; the logs carry revision/tree/command headers and the negative-control first line records the base-arm KeyError reproduction.
VERDICT diff: four commits add the queue telemetry and wait propagation, record the evidence, correct full/paused boundary states, and append the final landing prose. No unrelated code or operational state change is present.
CALL_SITES: 6 production call sites verified across generation admission, lane publication, snapshot rewriting, relay receipt completion, timeout refusal and receipt serialization.

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: all §20 semantics are implemented and covered: queue pressure is separate from engine capacity, top-level headroom is the minimum of engine and admission capacity, over-width and paused states are explicit, and gate wait is recorded on successful and timed-out requests.

JUSTIFICATION evidence: candidate logs provide the 65 and 66 passing gates, clean Ruff, and a base-arm red KeyError; the reviewed head independently passes the non-network 19-test subset and Ruff. The full rerun is not green only because this host rejects aiohttp loopback binds, and that limitation is preserved in the review log rather than presented as a candidate result.

SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: the focused tests cover congested, open, full, narrowed, paused, completed-wait and timeout-wait states, while the recorded base-arm negative control fails before the repair with KeyError: 'engine_headroom'.
